full_judgment: carries a sense of mandatory implication as a consequence. In so many legislations, as we have found, the legislatures to make a particular enactment mandatory, used some phraseologies to give it a mandatory meaning. For example section 96 (3)(a)(b) of State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 makes provision for depositing a legal amount prior to filing of a pre-emption case absolutely in a mandatory implication. The section starts with the words and phrases, "An application under sub-section (1) shall be dismissed".
